spellbook.finance/limitations: This reads only the customer represented by the MCP login. It accepts no email, user id, workspace, URL, credential, token, or shipping-address argument.
It returns stored SpellBook connection state only. It does not call ManaPool or prove that listings, order sync, payouts, or seller eligibility are currently working.
The account identifier is masked. The ManaPool access token and shipping address are never returned.

description: Check whether this signed-in customer's ManaPool seller account is connected to SpellBook Finance. Call this before requesting a setup link and again after the seller finishes the setup form. It returns a masked account identifier and stored connection timestamps. If connected is false, call spellbook_manapool_connect_link.
name: spellbook_manapool_connection_status
